title: Yellowish Dense Croatian Haggis Stew
description: A hearty and comforting Croatian dish featuring haggis, perfect for a sick day, with a dense and resinous texture, made with low sodium ingredients.

ingredients.name: haggis
ingredients.notes: traditional Scottish dish made from sheep's heart, liver, and lungs, mixed with onions, oatmeal, and spices

instructions: In a large pot, combine the chicken broth, sliced carrots, cubed potatoes, chopped onions, and minced garlic.
Bring the mixture to a boil over high heat, then reduce the heat to medium-low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Add the haggis to the pot, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks.
Add the paprika and black pepper to the pot and stir to combine.
Continue to simmer the stew for an additional 10 minutes, or until the haggis is cooked through and the vegetables are tender.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley or chives if desired.
Let the stew cool to room temperature before refrigerating or freezing it.
Reheat the stew over low heat, stirring occasionally, until warmed through.
